title: WorkerResult
description: Output of a single agent worker during /argus:team. Plugin scope keeps the artifact, metadata, and verification fields so failed or weak output never looks like a clean completion.

task.description: What the agent was asked to do.

framework.description: Thinking framework assigned. e.g., 'Analysis of Competing Hypotheses'.

result.description: The artifact this agent produced. null until status=done.

depends_on.description: Worker IDs that must complete before this one runs. For two-stage pipelines.

stage_id.description: Pipeline stage this worker belongs to. Single-stage problems: all workers share one stage.

verification_score.description: Per-worker quality/verification score when available. <70 means the result must be surfaced as challenged, not silently promoted.

verification_passed.description: Whether this worker output passed the plugin quality gate.

verification_feedback.description: Concise issues from quality gate, framework guard-rail, or verifier.

claim_ids.description: Claims in verification-ledger.json that cite this worker.
